summary: Bounded derived history page index, snapshot-change guard and source-bound metadata cache warming.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing SessionStore/EventStore and Web history adapter.
components.disposition: Derived local offset-only sidecar bound to the canonical JSON file identity; 1000–200000 messages, source <=128 MiB, indexed pages <=100 rows/8 MiB. No message body duplication, no new authority or service. Existing identity checks, event retraction projection and program.final hydration retained. Missing/stale/corrupt/unsupported indexes fall back to canonical load. Explicit bounded rebuild uses existing management/session locks; never on Web request. Snapshot revision guards continuation before/after read; changed source returns 409, client preserves existing page and offers re-read. Existing list/parent metadata cache warmed from successful save, full ingress authorization read unchanged.
evidence: 181 targeted Python tests passed, 67 WebUI files/668 tests passed, Ruff, Pyright, TypeScript passed.
Isolated storage page P95 0.175/0.173/0.175 ms at 1k/10k/100k messages, 100 samples each, event log disabled; cold full load 2.225/21.96/240.744 ms (single measurements).
Event enabled 1k/10k cold indexed page 2.552/23.166 ms; warm P95 0.259/0.482 ms. Event cold replay remains.

Write overhead measured and reduced using bytes.find: no-index vs index median 18.48→26.45 ms (10k), 197.03→258.06 ms (100k), three samples per arm, events disabled. Active Run write and end-to-end HTTP acceptance pending.

Regression covers exact page concatenation, restart, retraction, stale/corrupt source, deletion, explicit rebuild without source rewrite, workspace identity, concurrent revision change and frontend preservation.
components.verification_level: Local targeted tests passed. Independent final SHA review, original R9, remote CI, real workload and production acceptance pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Veto if offset index becomes an authorization source, if stale snapshot is silently mixed, if real write amplification or cold event replay violates latency budget, or if original content/retraction differs. Existing unindexed legacy and oversized paths remain fallback; independent cold list metadata and response byte-budget/expansion are not yet complete.
components.rollback_route: Revert code; derived .history.idx files are ignored by old readers and can be removed without changing canonical session/event data.
